what: CHARACTER's barber's book: every piece made on the 3D man, by kind, the names the barber's build takes, for RUN TWO [no two people alike]
rule: 121(i) and (k); Paolo 10/19: way more facial customization, hair options; the whole enchilada; hair first, hats rare
how_to_build: a roll file (python3 tools/bohemia_character_the_barbers_book.py roll <Gang> <n> <out.json>), then <venv>/bin/python tools/bohemia_character_the_barber_on_the_skull.py build PEOPLE:<out.json>, then per person <venv>/bin/python tools/bohemia_direction_master_rig.py records/character/rig/barber_person_<id>.glb records/target/character/barber/person_<id> --real-height <real_height_for_rig> --family none --clip Stand:1 --clip Anim_0:6 --portrait 128, then RUN's bake (tools/bohemia_bake_the_rig_cast.py) over those folders
recolour: every render's rig.json carries id_table (the material-ID pass): the hair is the material named barber_<tag>_hair; a crowd that needs more colours than it renders can re-tint those pixels by the id pass instead of re-rendering
